aka.anleitung.befoerdern: Promoting your own youngsters: use the “Sign” menu in the game; CalcioM notices it when reading (the player is no longer in the youth block). CalcioM brings in outside players through a transfer.
aka.anleitung.zurueckstufen: Demotion: the player trains and plays with the U23s again until you promote him. Meanwhile he is not part of the first team.
aka.anleitung.entlassen: Release: in the game, release the player from the youth squad; CalcioM no longer lists him in the meantime.
aka.anleitung.weg_a: CalcioM brings outside players into the first team with a transfer via path A; that path is not found yet for your own youngsters.
